name: Rental and business support

bnote.771001: No listed self-drive car rental company in India. Avis and Hertz are the largest in the US.
bnote.773003: Sanghvi Movers rents cranes in India. United Rentals and Ashtead are the world's largest equipment renters.
bnote.782000: India's two listed staffing companies, plus Randstad and Adecco. Thin margins are normal for staffing.
bnote.791100: Yatra is listed in India. MakeMyTrip is Indian but listed on Nasdaq. Thomas Cook, EaseMyTrip and ixigo appear under Section I.
bnote.801102: SIS is India's largest listed security-services company.
bnote.822000: Firstsource and eClerx are India's listed business-process companies.
bnote.829102: India's credit bureaus (CIBIL and others) are not listed. Experian, Equifax and TransUnion are the three global bureaus.

flags.mmyt: MakeMyTrip's profit is small after one-off items, so its P/E looks very high.
flags.cnxc: Concentrix booked a large goodwill write-down, so net profit is negative.
flags.htz: Hertz is loss-making after fleet write-downs.

notes: Section O: rental and support services
Staffing, travel booking, security guarding and outsourcing have listed Indian companies. Car and equipment rental, leasing and credit bureaus rely on companies abroad.
